errors.claim: An incident also closes when the monitor is edited and the new settings pass a check: 'Monitor edited and verified, incident closed' (service_monitors.sql ~L66).
errors.truth: That close is in save_service_monitor, which only accepts Stripe and Supabase monitors (p_type in ('stripe','supabase')). A website (HTTP) monitor is edited through update_monitor, which closes the open incident only when the target address changes, with 'Address changed, incident closed'. Any other edit leaves the incident open; the edit only resets the streak counters.

errors.claim: The 'Monitor edited and verified' close was added in 20261022081211_monitor_edit_closes_incident.sql.
errors.truth: That migration added the address-change close in update_monitor ('Address changed, incident closed'). The 'Monitor edited and verified' text first appears in 20261023100000_service_monitors.sql.

errors.claim: Network-level request failure cited as src/checks/http.ts:77-80.
errors.truth: Lines 77-80 are statusMatches. A network failure is returned at line 196 (exchange returning a failure kind). The behaviour described is right; only the citation is off.

errors.claim: A recovery email goes out only if an 'opened' alert was sent for that incident.
errors.truth: The trigger checks that an alert_events row of kind 'opened' exists (queued), not that it was delivered. It also requires the monitor's state to be up, or degraded for a 'down' incident.

Any edit that changes updated_at (and pause/resume) resets the pass/fail/slow streaks through a trigger, so an edit without an address change restarts recovery (probe_row_state.sql:19-40)
The outcome is applied by the monitor's home probe under a row lock (store.ts:303-353)

errors.claim: Editing a monitor and verifying the new version also closes its incident ('Monitor edited and verified, incident closed', service_monitors.sql:66).
errors.truth: This applies only to Stripe and Supabase monitors (save_service_monitor). An HTTP monitor's edit (update_monitor) closes the incident only on an address change, with 'Address changed, incident closed'. Other edits keep it open.

errors.claim: If no other probe is live, the same probe re-checks after 20 seconds.
errors.truth: The self re-check runs when no probe at another location is live (confirmersFor filters out same-location probes) or every peer declines. Another live probe at the same location does not count.

errors.truth: needsConfirmation is at lines 70-75. Line 63 is DEGRADED_AFTER; RECOVERED_AFTER is line 64. These are citation offsets only.
